hints: Express the distance $PQ$ using $v_Q = 20\text{ m s}^{-1}$: $s_{PQ} = v_Q t - \frac{1}{2}at^2$ with $t = 10\text{ s}$.
Express the distance $QR$ using $u_Q = 20\text{ m s}^{-1}$: $s_{QR} = u_Q t + \frac{1}{2}at^2$ with $t = 10\text{ s}$.
Use the given ratio $s_{QR} = 1.5 s_{PQ}$ to form a linear equation in $a$.
walkthrough:
State the kinematic equations linking distance, velocity, time, and constant acceleration:
For the motion from $P$ to $Q$, the velocity at the end of the interval is known ($v = 20\text{ m s}^{-1}$, $t = 10\text{ s}$):
$$s = vt - \frac{1}{2}at^2$$
$$s_{PQ} = 20 \times 10 - \frac{1}{2}a(10^2) = 200 - 50a$$

For the motion from $Q$ to $R$, the velocity at the start of the interval is known ($u = 20\text{ m s}^{-1}$, $t = 10\text{ s}$):
$$s = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2$$
$$s_{QR} = 20 \times 10 + \frac{1}{2}a(10^2) = 200 + 50a$$

Equate using the problem statement that $QR$ is $1.5$ times $PQ$:
$$s_{QR} = 1.5 \times s_{PQ}$$
$$200 + 50a = 1.5(200 - 50a)$$
Expand the right side:
$$1.5 \times 200 = 300, \quad 1.5 \times 50a = 75a$$
$$200 + 50a = 300 - 75a$$
Add $75a$ to both sides and subtract $200$:
$$125a = 100$$
Divide by $125$:
$$a = \frac{100}{125} = \frac{4}{5} = 0.8\text{ m s}^{-2}$$

hints: The total time from $Q$ to $S$ is $10 + 10 = 20\text{ s}$.
Calculate distance $QS$ using $s = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2$ with $u = 20\text{ m s}^{-1}$, $a = 0.8\text{ m s}^{-2}$, and $t = 20\text{ s}$.
Compute average speed as total distance divided by total time: $v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{QS}{20}$.
walkthrough:
Identify the total elapsed time between $Q$ and $S$:
The journey from $Q$ to $S$ spans two intervals ($QR$ and $RS$), each of $10\text{ s}$:
$$t_{QS} = 10 + 10 = 20\text{ s}$$

Calculate the displacement $s_{QS}$ with initial speed $u = 20\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and $a = 0.8\text{ m s}^{-2}$:
$$s = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2$$
$$s_{QS} = 20 \times 20 + \frac{1}{2} \times 0.8 \times 20^2$$
$$20 \times 20 = 400$$
$$\frac{1}{2} \times 0.8 \times 400 = 0.4 \times 400 = 160$$
$$s_{QS} = 400 + 160 = 560\text{ m}$$

Apply the definition of average speed:
$$\text{Average speed} = \frac{\text{Total distance}}{\text{Total time}} = \frac{560}{20} = 28\text{ m s}^{-1}$$
